AX-D12-REPEATED-IRRITANT-ICD.rationale: Independent review approved "irritant contact dermatitis" as COUNTERFACTUAL_CORRECT for LD-D12-01; feature SF-ONB2-REPEATED-IRRITANT is already bound to SU-D-12/LD-D12-01 in V4, PRESENT-direction is semantically sound (repeated irritant exposure present -> irritant CD legitimately tempting); this opportunity own frozen stem has this feature ABSENT, so the relation will not admit irritant CD for LD-D12-01 itself, consistent with the allergic-CD key.

FP-D04-MOBILE-MASS.rationale: Independent review (v4_route_bc_independent_review.json) verified SRC-MED-048-REC-01 verbatim names "a mobile lipoma" as the contrast to the epidermal cyst; the feature is genuinely new (absent from V4), scoped only to SU-D-04/LD-D04-01, no collision.

not_promoted_to_v5.reason: Independently APPROVED on clinical/citation grounds (v4_route_bc_independent_review.json), but NOT promoted into V5: the only available reused feature (SF-ONB2-INFANTILE-COURSE) is diagnostic OF THE KEY (infantile haemangioma growth-then-involution), not of the candidate (vascular malformation). The registry's new-anchor-relation mechanism (vocabulary_onboarding.build_extended_snapshot) requires required_state=PRESENT and only makes semantic sense when the anchored feature is characteristic of the TARGET (candidate) concept. Registering this feature at PRESENT to anchor vascular malformation would assert the medically backwards claim that a growth-then-involution course suggests malformation. Fixing this needs a new feature characterizing malformations own defining trait (e.g. present-at-birth, non-involuting, proportionate growth), not evidenced in the cited claim beyond naming the contrast category, and out of scope for this bounded wave.
